Done — but flagging a snag, because it matters: `edit_file` silently normalized the whole file to LF on write (61 → 54 bytes, every `\r` gone), so I restored CRLF with a byte-level conversion afterward. Net result is the file you asked for.

| Line | Content | Ending |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `name=demo` | CRLF |
| 2 | `host=0.0.0.0` | CRLF |
| 3 | `port=9090` | CRLF |
| 4 | `debug=false` | CRLF |
| 5 | `log=info` | CRLF |

59 bytes, `od -c` confirms `\r\n` on all five lines. Lines 1, 4 and 5 are untouched in content — only their terminator was repaired back to CRLF after the tool stripped it.
